title: Application upgrade
migrationRequired: Install the application updater through a trusted terminal before using this feature.
invalidPackage: Choose a .lup package no larger than 2 GiB.
impact: Recognition and preview will pause briefly. The device will verify the new version and attempt recovery on failure. Install now?
rollbackImpact: Restore the previous application and dependencies? Recognition and preview will pause briefly.
reconnecting: Device connection interrupted. Waiting for upgrade status.
retryHint: Select the same file to resume an interrupted upload. Submitted installations continue on the device. Older devices require initial migration.
